description: Canonical views for the scene regression suite (app/e2e/README.md). Each scene is a URL query of the real app (app/src/app/url.ts) rendered headless by scripts/e2e.mjs. `defaults` are merged under each scene's params (scenes adapt instantly, except those testing the eye's time dependence: adapt=realtime with an adaptfrom history); a scene's `tolerance` overrides the suite defaults in scripts/e2e-lib.mjs.
